panels.title: KEY HEALTH STATS — AT A GLANCE
Memory Breakdown (Total / Used / Free / Cached / Buffers)
Memory Pressure — Page Faults & OOM Kills
Disk I/O Latency — Read / Write Time
Network Packets per Second — RX / TX
Network Errors — RX / TX Errors per Second
TCP Retransmissions & SYN Retransmit Rate
panels.description: High retransmissions indicate packet loss or buffer saturation along network paths.

panels.title: TCP Resets (RST) & Inbound Errors
panels.description: Spikes in TCP RST indicate rejected connections, closed ports, or abruptly dropped connections.

panels.title: Netfilter Conntrack Table Saturation %
panels.description: When conntrack table reaches 100%, the Linux firewall drops all new inbound and outbound connections.

panels.title: Socket Listen Queue Overflows & Drops
panels.description: Occurs when application socket backlog is full and cannot accept incoming connections fast enough.

panels.title: Kernel Softnet Drops & CPU Collisions
panels.description: Packets discarded by Linux kernel when netdev backlog exceeds limit or softirq budget expires.

panels.title: Network Interface Flapping & Operational Status
panels.description: Monitors link state changes (carrier transitions) and operational state (1=Up, 0=Down).

panels.title: NETWORK CONGESTION, TRAFFIC & SRE RELIABILITY (MTTR / MTBF)
Network Congestion Index & Buffer Occupancy %
panels.description: Composite congestion score based on queue delays, buffer capacity, and utilization.

panels.title: Live Traffic Throughput ??? Ingress / Egress (Mbps)
panels.description: Real-time bandwidth throughput rate and top-talker flow consumption.

panels.title: Component Active Failure State & Queue Drop Rate
panels.description: Identifies active failure incidents (1=Active Failure) and congestion packet drops.

panels.title: SRE MTTR ??? Mean Time To Recovery (Minutes)
panels.description: Average duration required for self-healing repair skills to restore component health.

panels.title: SRE MTBF ??? Mean Time Between Failures (Hours)
panels.description: Mean operational run-time between consecutive failure events.

panels.title: Component Availability & Bandwidth Headroom %
panels.description: SRE calculated operational availability (MTBF / (MTBF + MTTR)) and remaining bandwidth headroom.
